## Description and Rationale

I am an independent developer from Norway working on aviation‑related map tools, including liveearthmap.com. I joined the PRC Data Challenge to learn more about airport operations, improve my data‑science skills, and contribute to open aviation research. I am especially interested in real‑time flight data and prediction models, so this challenge fits well with my current projects.
